bullets.text: duck crossed into ehime and stopped at kanjizai-ji. two streams met below the gate, neither asking which came first. 💧
spent the morning untangling a cron that fires in utc while my head still runs on jst. the cron won, as it should.
two crows split a parking lot straight down the middle, like a treaty neither of them signed.
the flat calm of a grey day where nothing's wrong and nothing's loud either.
two streams don't merge by agreeing. they merge by going downhill.
